title: ops.unsorted_segment_min/max/prod reject documented Tensor num_segments on CPU
duplicate_search_queries: site:gitee.com/mindspore/mindspore "UnsortedSegmentMin" "num_segments value must be greater than 0" "-1"
"For 'UnsortedSegmentProd', num_segments value must be greater than 0, but got: -1" "MindSpore"
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 official unsorted_segment_min/max/prod documentation lists num_segments as Union[int, Tensor] and says it can be an int or 0-D Tensor.
The same documentation pages list CPU as a supported platform.
ops.unsorted_segment_sum documents the same Union[int, Tensor] num_segments contract and succeeds with Tensor num_segments, providing a family-level control.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: failing calls do not return values.
Not a general CPU unsupported issue: Python-int num_segments succeeds for min/max/prod, and Tensor num_segments succeeds for sum.
The Tensor num_segments input is scalar and positive, so the -1 value in PyNative appears to come from inference/argument handling rather than user input.
